name: print-social-blogging-infographics-icon-header-with-three-column-stats
title: 'Blogging Infographics' with a flat-icon header strip and a three-column layout of stats, charts and icons
whatItIs: A white infographic with a row of flat icons and illustrated props (blogger at a laptop, megaphone, monitor, camera, coffee cup) as a header strip above a bold teal 'Blogging Infographics' title bar, then three columns (Bloggers, Blog Management, Content) each mixing a stat (55% total blogging population, 21–35 years old), age-group bars, growth arrows (50%/95%/410%), reader statistics (140 million, 39% men/61% women) and content-type percentages (Photos 30%, Video 40%).
whatItMeans: Dense but navigable; the icon header and column structure let a stat-heavy infographic stay organised.
techniques: Open an infographic with a row of topic icons and props as a visual index.
Organise mixed content types (bars, percentages, icons) into consistent columns.
Colour-code the header bar to anchor the whole piece.

vocabulary.definition: A row of icons previewing an infographic's topics.
Content organised into three parallel vertical sections.
